title: Beyond the Anemic Domain Model: Leveraging Java 17 and Spring Data for Bulletproof Business Logic
description: Moving beyond anemic domain models in enterprise Java. Harness Java 17 records for immutable value objects, sealed interfaces for exhaustive state machines, and Spring Data JPA for bulletproof business logic.

title: Securing Cloud-Native Java Microservices with JWT, RBAC & Zero-Trust Architecture
description: A comprehensive guide to hardening Java 17 and Spring Boot microservices on Kubernetes using OAuth2/OIDC, cryptographically verified JWT tokens, and fine-grained RBAC.

title: Event-Driven Architecture with Kafka: Guaranteeing Idempotency & Exactly-Once Semantics
description: How to design rock-solid event-driven microservices using Apache Kafka, transactional outbox pattern, and idempotent consumer semantics in financial platforms.

title: Enterprise Domain-Driven Design & Contract-First OpenAPI Architecture
description: How to govern system-to-system integrations and eliminate distributed monoliths across multi-country teams using DDD bounded contexts and OpenAPI 3.0 specs.

title: Building High-Throughput Reactive Microservices with Spring Boot 3 & WebFlux
description: A deep architectural dive into designing non-blocking, event-driven reactive services in Java 17 and Spring Boot 3, contrasting thread-per-request with event-loop architectures.
